title: •Attark
caption: •Attark (V)
game_text: During your control phase, if No Love For The Empire on table, may retrieve a non-unique alien of a different species than your Rep.
lore: From a mysterious species known only as Hoovers. Possesses tremendous technical abilities. Small size allows him to easily manipulate detailed electronic equipment.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2, third box blank; deploy 2 / forfeit 3. Icon column empty (only the set sphere). Alien (Jabba's Palace frame, alien disc). Slip text matches the stub. Lore corrected from the scan: 'known only as Hoovers' (wiki 'known as') and 'to easily manipulate' (wiki 'easy'); 'electronic' read as printed though the 350 px scan is soft there (the r merges with the o; could be misread as 'electonic'). No characteristic in lore. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1998 (Jabba's Palace) not legible on it. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
